description: This file defines an Android Activity named PictureInPicture that demonstrates the usage and management of Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode. It includes UI controls for configuring PiP options, handles layout changes, manages PiP actions, and interacts with other activities related to PiP behavior.

classes.name: PictureInPicture
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating Picture-in-Picture features and UI controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Activity, sets up UI references, listeners, and default states.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets up PiP actions when activity starts.

methods.name: onUserLeaveHint
methods.description: Automatically enters PiP mode when user leaves if auto PiP is disabled.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles layout updates on configuration change.

methods.name: onPictureInPictureModeChanged
methods.description: Resets UI elements upon exiting PiP mode.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receivers when activity stops.

methods.name: enterContentPip
methods.description: Launches a separate PiP activity with source rect hint and aspect ratio.

methods.name: updateLayout
methods.description: Adjusts UI layout based on device orientation and mode.

methods.name: setupPipActions
methods.description: Initializes remote actions for PiP controls.

methods.name: setupTabletLandscapeLayout
methods.description: Configures layout for tablet in landscape mode.

methods.name: setupFullScreenLayout
methods.description: Configures layout for full screen mode.

methods.name: enterOnePaneMode
methods.description: Sets layout to single pane mode.

methods.name: enterFullScreenMode
methods.description: Enables full-screen mode by hiding system UI.

methods.name: updatePictureInPictureParams
methods.description: Builds and sets PiP parameters like source rect, aspect ratio, and actions.

methods.name: updateContentPosition
methods.description: Rearranges views based on selected position (start/end).
